four_layer_diagnosis.prerequisites: MISSING -- the replay channel was structurally dead. mech285_n_draws read 0 on all 75 firings per block in the BASELINE arm where it was supposed to be UNSUPPRESSED, so replay_channel_baseline_reachable failed (0.0 vs >= 1.0).
four_layer_diagnosis.implementation: partial -- Build 1 (precision-scaled commit temperature) and Build 2 (eval-boundary sleep interleave) both engaged: precision_scaled_commit engaged on 75.4% of selections and the sleep cycle fired 25 times per block on every seed. The replay POOL, not the sampler, was empty.
four_layer_diagnosis.environment: wrong pressures -- the positive control FAILED WITH REVERSED SIGN: baseline avoidant-action rate in the HIGH hazard band minus the SAFE band measured -0.4307 against a +0.05 floor, on all three seeds (-0.026, -0.476, -0.789). Baseline agents were markedly MORE avoidant in the safe band. The DV/env pairing is not hazard-sensitive, which invalidates anything built on top of it.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: misleading -- three criteria were unreachable by construction. (a) C1_false_alarm_elevation set a threshold of 2 x 0.5771 = 1.1542 on a DV BOUNDED IN [0,1] -- unattainable by any value once the pooled baseline exceeded 0.5, which it did on all three seeds. (b) precision_margin_norm_elevated_under_hv: the baseline pooled margin is 0.99980, so the arithmetic ceiling on the elevation is 0.000195 against a floor of 0.01 -- 51x larger; the measured 0.000194 is 99.4% of ALL available headroom. (c) commit_temperature_reduced_under_hv is ALGEBRAICALLY THE SAME QUANTITY read through a different sample filter (T_eff = 1.0 + alpha*(1 - margin) with alpha = 1.0), so it is not an independent check and is equally unreachable.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: partially coupled -- the anchor pool's only producer was off, so a downstream consumer chain ran on an empty set.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-981 (2026-09-03) NON-CONTRIBUTORY. The run's self-route to substrate_not_ready_requeue is CORRECT and is confirmed here; four of eleven readiness preconditions failed. (1) REPLAY CHANNEL STRUCTURALLY DEAD, and the root cause is precise: mech285_n_draws read 0 on every one of 75 firings per block in the BASELINE arm, where replay was supposed to be unsuppressed. The sampler existed and ran -- a missing sampler would have recorded the driver's -1 sentinel, not 0 -- and drew 50 times per firing, receiving None each time because AnchorSet.all_with_dual_trace() was always empty. The only live anchor-install path is consume_boundary_events -> write_anchor, which runs only when sense() emits BoundaryEvents, which requires hippocampal.use_event_segmenter -- default False at ree_core/utils/config.py:2761, and the driver never sets it. The driver sets latent.use_event_classifier, a different flag on a different sub-config. THE THREE-FLAG RECIPE IS INCOMPLETE: V3-EXQ-909, cited as the reachability precedent, inherited use_event_segmenter=True from V3-EXQ-906b's config, and 909's own precondition measured the CONFIGURED knob (draws_per_cycle 50.0, 'structural, all seeds'), not measured draws. use_anchor_sets + use_mech285_sampler + use_mech272_routing are necessary but not sufficient; use_event_segmenter is the missing fourth. (2) POSITIVE CONTROL FAILED WITH REVERSED SIGN (-0.4307 vs +0.05 floor, all three seeds) -- the DV/env pairing is not hazard-sensitive, so no criterion built on avoidant-action rate is trustworthy here. (3) THREE CRITERIA WERE UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION: C1 set 2x a pooled baseline of 0.5771 = 1.1542 as a threshold on a DV bounded in [0,1]; the precision-margin elevation had an arithmetic ceiling of 0.000195 against a 0.01 floor (51x) and the measured value used 99.4% of it; and commit_temperature_reduced_under_hv is algebraically the same quantity, not an independent check. (4) C2 'PASSED' ON A RATIO OF TWO NEGATIVES (-0.04355 / -0.05198 = 0.8377): HV was BELOW baseline, so there was no elevation to revert. Red-team F6 moved C2 from per-seed to pooled to stop sign-flips; the pooled form has the identical pathology when the pooled elevation is negative. Also noted: replay_channel_non_degenerate 'passed' vacuously at measured == threshold == 0.0 -- p0_readiness_gate applies the inclusive `m <= t` when no comparator key is present, and the measured quantity is a non-negative count pinned at 0 by construction, so it could not have failed; only its paired reachability check carried information.

learning_extracted: The V3-EXQ-909 'three-flag replay recipe' (use_anchor_sets + use_mech285_sampler + use_mech272_routing) is INCOMPLETE and has now propagated into a second driver. It needs a fourth flag, hippocampal.use_event_segmenter, whose default is False. 909 itself never demonstrated measured draws -- its precondition read the configured knob.
A precondition that measures a CONFIGURED knob is not a reachability check. 909's precondition read draws_per_cycle = 50; 981's read measured draws = 0 under the same nominal configuration.

A readiness check whose measured quantity is a non-negative count with threshold 0 and inclusive direction `upper` cannot fail. It is informative only when paired with a reachability check on the same instrument, as it was here.

A multiplicative pass threshold (2x baseline) on a DV bounded in [0,1] is unattainable whenever the baseline exceeds 0.5 -- a purely arithmetic error that no amount of running can overcome, and one a static lint could catch.

Two preconditions can be algebraically the same quantity wearing different names (precision margin and commit temperature, via T_eff = 1.0 + alpha*(1 - margin)), giving false reassurance of independent confirmation.
